## [0.32.1] - 2026-09-17

Density no longer shrinks things that need a floor of their own. Read this
before updating if you use anything other than Default density.

### Fixed

- **The tab strip, drawer header, response toolbar, and update/recovery banners hold a fixed height at every density** instead of shrinking as low as 24px at Default.
- **Every interactive control now clears the 24x24px touch-target minimum at every density** - switches, checkboxes, toasts, dialog and tab close buttons, and the history sidebar's pin/delete buttons no longer shrink as low as 21px, 15px or 12px.
- **Icons hold a fixed 16px (or 12px for compact icons) floor** instead of shrinking to 9px at Default density.
